# typosquat-detector

> Flag PyPI and npm package names that imitate popular packages: homoglyphs, separator tricks, affixes and one-edit typos against a bundled, overridable popular list Python package `trysac-typosquat-detector`, import name `typosquat_detector`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
